## Architectural Improvement

Before this refactoring:
- 34 scattered `load_dotenv()` calls
- Inconsistent environment loading order
- Potential for race conditions and configuration bugs

After this refactoring:
- Single entry point: `src/config/env.py`
- Entry points (scripts, orchestrators) call `load_env()` or `bootstrap_phase()`
- Source modules no longer call `load_dotenv()` - they expect the entry point to have loaded the environment
- Cleaner, more predictable configuration management
